uncertainties: Marurur's descriptive nicknames preserved as Mr. Whiskers, Mr. Flappy, Mr. Stripes, and Mr. Smiley pending established nickname check.
text:
We went to pick fruit
with Mr. Whiskers and the others,
and the fire was roaring away...
We all rushed
to put it out.
Fwahahaha!
You should be grateful to us!
Y-yeah...
Thank you very much.
Oh, well...
Y-you're welcome.
Neither place is somewhere
a fire could have been left unattended.
And considering that
in both cases, the settlements
were downwind...
An incendiary attack...
An incendiary attack...
If so,
it must be the work
of the Imperial Army.
If so,
that would mean
the Imperial Army...
...
...
...
...
Will they target another
settlement next, or
our ship...?
Either way,
we need to stay alert.
But doesn't just sitting here
waiting to be attacked
make you mad?
PHLAIZ IS ALREADY
ON THE MOVE...
FROM THE SKY,
PHLAIZ SHOULD BE ABLE
TO FIND THEIR LOCATION...
Then for now,
let's wait for that report.
Right...
Yes...
Oh! Mr. Flappy
is back!
●.
What did you find?
What did you find?
The Imperial Army was
moving through the forest.
From above, they appeared
to be in quite a hurry...
They must be planning
to set somewhere else
on fire!
We have to stop them...
We have to stop them...
I have already
informed Lord Falzen.
I shall go straight to Latrix
and bring
Ardylia here.
Then Marurur will
go and get
Mr. Stripes!
Wait a moment,
Marurur.
Yes?
We're about to
go and fight
the Imperial Army, but...
While we're away,
I'd like you to
keep an eye on Ishlar.

go and fight
